request.title: Show a crossed-out "regular price" on the paywall?
request.why: Reference pricing touches consumer-protection rules and how honest the product feels; that is the owner's call.
request.context: A crossed-out higher price usually lifts conversion, but the app has never actually sold at that higher price.

options.label: Show a real time-limited intro price
options.detail: Actually sell at $6.99 later, so the reference is true.

request.rec_reason: A reference price that was never charged can be treated as misleading in several markets.

ack.note: Paywall shows $3.49 only; the A/B variant with a reference price was removed.
